inTheSaucer.say: Grey: Oh no. Oh no, no, no. The human is awake!
Other grey: Why is it doing that thing with its eyes? I hate the eye thing.
Grey: Put it back to sleep! No. Not that button. NOT THAT ONE. That one is the radio!
Saucer radio: *crackle* ...smooth jazz, all night long... *crackle*
Narrator: Some time later. How much later is a secret. Even the President is not allowed to know.

inThePines.say: Grey: Hey. Hey, buddy. Wake up. You gotta wake up.

Other grey: Sorry about the whole abduction thing. Really. We grabbed the wrong human. Paperwork.
Good news: you are home, and we only probed you a little.
Bad news: we have to leave you something.
Grey: You have bigger problems now. MUCH bigger problems.
Other grey: Okay! We are leaving now! Bye!

Grey: Do what this book says.
Or your whole planet is toast. That is not a threat. We love toast.
But something bad is coming. Bad, bad, BAD. We never say bad three times.
Voice from the saucer: Guys! Get in! We are parked over a national forest, and IT is waking up. Go, go, go!
You: ...Gary is going to be so mad he slept through this.
